mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal dysfunction that may alter methadone metabolism and increase risk of QT prolongation; both agents have potential cardiac effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially calcium and magnesium), ECG for QT prolongation, and methadone levels; adjust methadone dose if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy.
